AlphaSDM: Species Distribution Modeling using Alpha Earth Embeddings

Source: R/AlphaSDM-package.R
AlphaSDM-package.Rd

Tools for species distribution modeling with Google's Alpha Earth satellite embeddings, with all computationally intensive work performed server-side on Google Earth Engine.
